actions: Rotate the iOS simulator (or device) to landscape and confirm 1-3 digit (32pt), 4-5 digit (13pt), and 6-digit 1536/3072+ (9pt) numerals stay legible at the smallest landscape tile.
Confirm the min-tile floor keeps tiles at >= ~44pt on a typical landscape window and numerals never clip, then record the evidence in the spec completion note.
